what_it_holds: Ctrip.csv — scraped Chinese-travel-platform (Ctrip/Trip.com) attraction-page data, plus a Jupyter notebook (Ctrip.ipynb) documenting the scraping/preprocessing/visualization pipeline and a rendered chart image. Exact fields, row count, and scrape date not confirmed from the README.
